notes.source: Operator claimable table supplied 2026-10-29 morning UTC. Amounts as displayed; token_prices = operator_USD / amount (epoch-1785974400 convention).
notes.dedupe: The UI printed 12 lines for 9 distinct tokens. USDC appeared as a combined line 1,199.96/$1,199.31 followed by FEES 7.6577/$7.65 and BRIBES 1,192.3/$1,191.65. Components dropped; the amount uses the more precise component sum (USDC 1,199.9577) and the combined line's USD. AMZNc, wtMU and MUc showed '< $0.01' and are recorded with amounts but no price, so they count as $0. Deduped total $1,207.53 matches the stated total.
notes.epoch_context: Epoch 1793232000 opened 2026-10-29T00:00:00Z (boundary block 53221327, ts 1793232001). Votes were cast during epoch 1792627200. All three boundary phases landed: run 202 (phase 1, k=7, sent 23:56:33Z), run 203 (phase 2, k=6, sent 23:59:23Z), run 204 (phase 3, k=8, sent 23:59:46Z, block 53221320, send-time expected $1,240.94), which is the binding allocation. The backup vote, run 201 (2026-10-28T14:21Z, k=17, expected $4,985.13), was replaced. Its high expectation came from real USDC bribes ($1,000-$4,100 per pool on 17 pools) that other voters had not yet piled into; by phase 1 the same pools paid about a quarter as much per vote.
notes.carryover_check: The epoch-1792627200 pot was fully claimed on 2026-10-22 (72 of 72 escrow batches), so this table should hold only this epoch's rewards; the claim's balance deltas confirm it.
notes.headline: Realised $1,207.53 ($0.6658 per 1k votes against $0.6891 last epoch). Against run 204's realized-at-boundary entitlement of $1,207.67 it is -$0.15; all 9 tokens reconcile at a 1.0000 amount ratio, and the USD difference is price movement since the boundary snapshot.
notes.opportunity_gap: Boundary optimum $1,250.91 at k=50 against run 204's realized-at-boundary $1,207.67: an executed gap of $43.24 (3.5%), against 6.4% last epoch. k=50 is the sweep's upper bound, but the curve is flat past k=20 ($1,249.54), so a wider sweep would not move the optimum materially. Run 204's send-time expectation of $1,240.94 fell $33.26 by the boundary, 14 seconds later. Denylist cost -$0.91 (reported as negative: the unrestricted sweep found $1,250.00, below the restricted $1,250.91, so the heuristic sweep is not monotone in the candidate set; treat it as $0). Price basis is phase 1's snapshot (ts 1793231767, ~4 min before the boundary).
notes.price_feed: The routing-divergence audit found no unhandled persistent overprice. The 2026-10-28 dry run kept wtTSM at its CoinGecko reference $430.35 against a $0.0018 routing quote; it was worth $2.72 across all pools and none we voted for.
notes.claim_swap_outcome: Claimed and swapped 2026-10-29. 88 of 88 escrow claim batches successful (--claim-source escrow, 44 gauges: the union of the backup vote and all three phases), no rate-limit retries. Balance deltas matched the table at a 1.0000 ratio for every token (wtQQQM 1.0023 and wtMU 1.0001 from UI rounding): gross received $1,207.53. The router-batch swap delivered 8.857154 USDC for 4 legs (wtNKE, wtTR, wtNVDA, wtIAU) marked at $8.86 (-0.001%); the wtNKE leg included last epoch's 0.018592 wtNKE dust (~$0.69). Nine tokens below the $1 dust threshold or on the skip list were left unswapped, of which this epoch's are wtQQQM, AMZNc, wtMU and MUc (about $0.06). End state 1,208.816752 USDC = 1,199.959598 claimed + 8.857154 swapped. Gas 0.000357 ETH: 0.000348 claims, 0.000010 approvals and executeSwaps.
